title: The complete history of the Bears-Packers rivalry

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The complete history of the Bears-Packers rivalry
sources.description: The Bears and Packers have been battling since 1921, when the Chicago Staleys beat the Green Bay Packers 20-0 at Cubs Park. WCG historian Jack M Silverstein looks back at the stars, highlights and power swings in the greatest rivalry in sports.
